name: composer-answers-help
seed: php artisan mock:sample-day everyday --email=<account> && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\TravelSeeder" && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\PaperworkSeeder" && E2E_EMAIL=<account> COMPOSER_ANSWERS=help php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\ComposerAnswersSeeder"

init: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new MutationObserver(() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.chat-bar'); if (bar && !bar.hidden) bar.hidden = true; }).observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden'] }));

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new MutationObserver(() => document.querySelectorAll('.chat-entry p').forEach((p) => { if (p.textContent.endsWith(' In this preview my answers use sample data.')) p.textContent = p.textContent.replace(' In this preview my answers use sample data.', ''); })).observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true }));

screenshotStyleReason: The text box band is fixed over the conversation on both sides, so it is hidden only while answers are shot, as are each side's header and its floating Composer button.
mockInitReason: The mock's bar above its answers says they're samples (“Sample answers from the sample day · nothing here is live”); the app's aren't, so it has no such bar. It stays hidden on the mock (its own hidden state, .chat-bar[hidden] + .chat-feed), so both conversations start at the same place. Its help reply ends “In this preview my answers use sample data.”; the app's answers are the person's own, so that sentence is taken off the mock's reply and both replies are compared whole.
